beats.caption: Altadoo. Here is the story of Altadoo and its 27 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 103, 97 and 69 people in Altadoo, in 25, 22 and 20 households. Heads of household included Gallagher, Kennedy and McGinley.
Here are the families of Altadoo, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Campbell and McGinley families.
